The Modern Alternative

Your browser is already a presentation engine

An HTML slide is a few lines of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, rendered natively in any browser

  • Reveal.js — the most popular open-source framework, with transitions and plugins
  • Slidev — developer-friendly, Markdown-driven slides powered by Vue
  • Marp — turns Markdown into slide decks with a minimal workflow
  • Impress.js — CSS3 transforms for cinematic, spatial presentations
<!-- one slide, plain text -->
<section class="slide">
  <h2>Your browser is the projector</h2>
  <p>Rendered by any modern browser.</p>
</section>
98% of devices worldwide run a modern browser, so every one of them is already a presentation engine.
